content:
Marco: FYI SI Apex / VoltEdge asked to co-list a pre-built image (Dedicated + VoltEdge appliance) in the cloud marketplace. Before we say yes, need a short operational play for lead capture + ownership.

Priya: High level thoughts: 1) partner registers pipeline in our partner portal; 2) partner claims within 48h of lead; 3) if existing AE has active contact, AE retains ownership.

Owen: Can we tighten claim window to 24h for marketplace leads? marketplace leads convert fast. 48h feels long.

Marco: 24h ok but add auto-notify and one reminder at 12h. if no claim -> assign to partner queue.

Priya: Also include mapping rules: tag account with "volt-edge" or "si-apex"; if ARR > 150k or legal contract present -> AE priority.

legal-bot: Note: joint listing requires a Marketplace Partner Addendum signed + joint press pre-approval. Legal needs 3 business days for review.

Owen: Ops notes: POC flows should have a clear handback. After partner POC completion, partner submits conversion form with link to SFDC opp id. That triggers pipeline transfer workflow.

Marco: Drafting quick pseudo rules to include in doc:

```
# routing rules
if account.tags contains "volt-edge" or "si-apex":
  if account.ARR > 150000 or account.legal_status == "contracted":
    owner = "AE"
  else if partner.claimed_within_hours <= 24:
    owner = "Partner_Apex"
  else:
    owner = "Partner_Queue"
else:
  owner = "Redwood_Direct"
```

Priya: Add SLA: partner must respond to inbound lead within 8 business hours after claim. AE escalation window 48 business hours.

ops: Ops will add the SFDC field mapping and a canned email template for partner claims.

Marco: Can we run this in pilot for VoltEdge listings only for 6 weeks, measure conversion velocity, then generalize?

Owen: +1 to pilot. we'll need tracking tags and a dashboard.

legal-bot: Reminder: upload signed addendum to the partner folder before listing.

Priya: I'll put a one-page playbook in Confluence and schedule a 30min pilot kickoff Thurs 10am PT.

Marco: Great. Thanks all — see Confluence link when ready.
